def factor_overnight_intraday_reversal_10d(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy['close'], df_copy['open'])
    diff = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    lagged_diff = diff.shift(1)
    reversal_rank = -lagged_diff.rolling(10, min_periods=10).rank(pct=True)
    df_copy['factor_overnight_intraday_reversal_10d'] = reversal_rank
    return df_copy['factor_overnight_intraday_reversal_10d']
description: Mutation of factor_overnight_intraday_reversal: reduces rolling rank window from 20 to 10. The core reversal mechanism is unchanged: yesterday's overnight-intraday return differential signals reversal, ranked negatively. A shorter window makes the time-series normalization more responsive to recent dynamics, potentially enhancing IC and ICIR while preserving the cross-sectional ranking advantage. This minimal intervention avoids adding new components.
